display_fil: Tagas; maling printout; gamit na hindi makita. Itala ang nakita at hindi pa alam.
display_en: Leak; wrong printout; misplaced materials. Record observations and unknowns.
narration_fil:
Si BHW Charlaine ay naghahanda ng health teaching sa isang kathang-isip na BHS. Bagong adaptasyon ang usapan, hindi sipi sa DOH. Nakikita niya ang tumutulong gripo, mga printout na maling bersyon at teaching materials na hindi makita. “Isusulat ko muna ang nakita,” sabi niya. “Hindi ko pa alam ang bill, dami ng nasayang o dahilan ng kakulangan.”

Tubig ang resource sa gripo; papel, printing energy at oras ang maaaring masayang sa maling printout; oras at posibleng dobleng order ang kaugnay ng nawawalang gamit. Ang obserbasyon ay hindi pa sukat ng konsumo o patunay na kulang ang budget. Itala ang nakitang pangyayari at kung ano ang hindi pa napatutunayan.

Iulat ang tagas sa nakatalagang supervisor ayon sa lokal na proseso. Huwag mag-ayos ng tubo, magsara ng critical equipment o bawasan ang tubig para sa hand hygiene. Protektahan ang cold chain, kinakailangang ventilation, tamang accessible na impormasyon at agarang serbisyo. Dummy paper materials lamang ang gagamitin sa practice.
narration_en:
BHW Charlaine is preparing health teaching in a fictional BHS. The dialogue is a new adaptation, not a DOH quotation. She sees a dripping tap, wrong-version printouts and teaching materials that cannot be found. “I will record what I saw first,” she says. “I do not yet know the bill, amount wasted or reason for a shortage.”

Water is the tap's resource; paper, printing energy and time may be wasted on wrong printouts; searching time and possible duplicate ordering relate to misplaced materials. An observation is not a consumption measurement or proof of an insufficient budget. Record the observed event and what remains unverified.

Report the leak to the designated supervisor through the local process. Do not repair plumbing, switch off critical equipment or reduce water for hand hygiene. Protect cold-chain systems, required ventilation, correct accessible information and timely urgent services. Practice uses dummy paper materials only.

display_fil: May apat na luma; walang current sa kit. Pumili muna ng ligtas na hakbang.
display_en: Four outdated copies; no current version in the kit. Choose a safe next step.

check.prompt_fil: May apat na lumang handout at walang kasalukuyang bersyon sa kit. Ano ang ligtas na susunod na hakbang?
check.prompt_en: The kit has four outdated handouts and no current version. What is the safe next step?

options.fil: Ipamahagi ang luma para hindi masayang.
options.en: Distribute the old copies so they are not wasted.

options.fil: Palitan ang label at ituring na aprubado ang luma.
options.en: Relabel the old copies as approved.

options.fil: Ihiwalay ang luma, tiyakin ang aprubadong master at humingi ng kasalukuyang kopya.
options.en: Set aside the old copies, verify the approved master and request current copies.

check.feedback_fil: 1. Hindi ligtas: maaaring maling impormasyon ang maipamahagi kapag ginamit ang luma. 2. Hindi sapat ang pagpapalit ng label; hindi nito ginagawang aprubado ang materyal. 3. Tama: ihiwalay ang luma, tiyakin ang aprubadong master at humingi ng current copies. Sa kathang-isip na correction, ibinukod ni Charlaine ang apat na luma at humingi ng kumpirmasyon sa supervisor. Wala pang current sa kit; iniulat ang pangangailangan, hindi sinabing may dumating na.
check.feedback_en: 1. Unsafe: distributing outdated copies may spread incorrect information. 2. Changing a label does not approve the material. 3. Correct: set aside old copies, verify the approved master and request current copies. In the fictional correction, Charlaine separates the four outdated copies and asks the supervisor for confirmation. The kit still has no current version; the need is reported without claiming delivery.

narration_fil:
Ituro ang may-label na imbakan at ihambing ang teaching materials sa master na kinumpirma ng awtorisadong supervisor. Ang label na “approved” na isinulat ng sarili ay hindi patunay ng approval. Bilangin lamang ang kasalukuyang magagamit na kopya; huwag isama ang luma, expired o sirang materyal sa usable count.

Sa quiz, may apat na lumang handout at walang kasalukuyang bersyon sa kit. Ito ang ibinigay na facts; wala pang napatunayang approved master o kasalukuyang kopya. “Sayang ang papel,” sabi ng katrabaho. “Ano ang ligtas na hakbang?” Pumili muna bago basahin ang feedback.

Ihiwalay at iulat ang maling bersyon, expired o sirang gamit ayon sa lokal na procedure. Huwag ipamahagi o palitan lang ang label para maubos. Sa practice, papel na cards lamang ang kumakatawan sa mga ito; walang tunay na gamot. Ibalik ang reusable teaching materials sa tamang puwesto pagkatapos gamitin. Hindi nito pinahihintulutan ang clinical reuse o reprocessing.
narration_en:
Point out labeled storage and compare teaching materials with a master confirmed by the authorized supervisor. Writing “approved” on a label yourself does not establish approval. Count only current usable copies; exclude outdated, expired or damaged material from the usable count.

In the quiz, the kit has four outdated handouts and no current version. These are the given facts; an approved master and current copies have not yet been verified. “Wasting paper feels wrong,” the colleague says. “What is the safe step?” Choose before reading feedback.

Separate and report incorrect versions, expired or damaged items under local procedure. Do not distribute them or simply change their labels to use them up. Practice represents these with paper cards only; no real medicine is handled. Return reusable teaching materials to their location after use. This does not authorize clinical reuse or reprocessing.

heading_fil: Label, bilang, balik: may taong responsable
display_fil: Label → usable count → balik. Role, checklist at susunod na check. Panatilihin ang pitong S.
display_en: Label → usable count → return. Role, checklist and next check. Retain all seven S meanings.
narration_fil:
Ipinakita ni Charlaine ang routine gamit ang dummy teaching kit. Tinukoy niya ang puwesto at malinaw na label, binilang ang usable paper cards laban sa checklist, at ibinalik ang bawat reusable card matapos gamitin. “Sino ang titingin bago at pagkatapos gamitin?” tanong niya. Pangalan ng nakatalagang role at petsa ng susunod na check ang isusulat, hindi pagpapalagay na may gumawa na.

Panatilihin ang pitong S: Sort—alisin ang hindi kailangan; Systematize—ayusin ang kailangan; Sweep—linisin ang lugar; Standardize—pare-parehong paraan; Safety—gawing ligtas; Self-discipline—gawin ang tungkulin nang hindi laging inuutusan; Sustain—ipagpatuloy ang routine. Ang linis ng lugar ay hindi instruction sa clinical decontamination. Sundin ang aprubadong lokal na cleaning policy.

Magkaiba ang pagkakasunod ng 7S sa Reference Manual at Facilitator Guide; hindi natin binabago ang kanilang sipi. Mahalaga ang lahat ng pitong kahulugan, malinaw na pananagutan at periodic check. Hindi sapat ang isang general cleaning kung babalik ang kalat. Ang ipinakitang routine ay hindi pa patunay ng nasukat na savings.
narration_en:
Charlaine demonstrates the routine with a dummy teaching kit. She identifies its location and clear label, counts usable paper cards against a checklist, and returns every reusable card after use. “Who checks before and after use?” she asks. Record the assigned role and next check date without assuming someone has already completed it.

Retain all seven S meanings: Sort—remove unnecessary items; Systematize—arrange what is needed; Sweep—clean the area; Standardize—use a consistent method; Safety—make it safe; Self-discipline—carry out responsibility without constant reminders; Sustain—keep the routine going. Workplace tidiness is not a clinical decontamination instruction. Follow approved local cleaning policy.

The Reference Manual and Facilitator Guide order the seven S terms differently; their quotations are not rewritten here. All seven meanings, clear responsibility and periodic checking matter. One general cleanup is insufficient if disorder returns. Demonstrating a routine does not yet establish measured savings.

display_fil: Nakita / natiyak / hindi pa alam. Practice: 6 kailangan − 3 usable = 3 gap; iulat.
display_en: Observed / verified / unknown. Practice: 6 needed − 3 usable = 3 gap; report it.
narration_fil:
Gumamit ng tatlong field: nakita, natiyak, hindi pa alam. Sa hiwalay na kathang-isip na practice card, kailangan ng anim na kasalukuyang handout. Kinumpirma ng dummy supervisor card ang practice master B; may tatlong usable B sa imbakan at apat na lumang A sa hiwalay na pile. Practice quantities lamang ito, hindi bagong facts sa quiz.

Nakita: may luma at kulang ang kasalukuyang kopya para sa practice task. Natiyak: tatlong usable B laban sa anim na kailangan; tatlong current copies ang gap sa halimbawang ito. Hindi pa alam: actual approval sa totoong BHS, gastos, budget at delivery date. Hindi usable stock ang apat na lumang A. Hindi rin sapat ang “hindi makita” upang sabihing ubos na.

Sabi ni Charlaine, “Ilalagay ko ang verified version, usable count at kailangan sa request. Iuulat ko ang natitirang gap; hindi ko sasabihing naayos na.” Supervisor ang magpapasya sa tunay na request ayon sa lokal na proseso. Ang audit ay ebidensya para sa susunod na hakbang, hindi awtorisasyon o patunay ng financial savings.
narration_en:
Use three fields: observed, verified, unknown. In a separate fictional practice card, six current handouts are needed. A dummy supervisor card confirms practice master B; storage has three usable B copies and four outdated A copies in a separate pile. These quantities are illustrative practice inputs, not new quiz facts.

Observed: outdated material and too few current copies for the practice task. Verified: three usable B copies against six needed; the illustrative gap is three current copies. Unknown: actual approval in a real BHS, costs, budget and delivery date. Four outdated A copies are not usable stock. “Cannot be found” also does not establish zero stock.

Charlaine says, “I will put the verified version, usable count and need in the request. I will report the remaining gap, not say it is fixed.” The supervisor decides a real request under local procedure. An audit supports a next step; it is not authorization or proof of financial savings.

heading_fil: Tatlong row at aktuwal na demonstrasyon
heading_en: Three rows and an actual demonstration
display_fil: Tatlong audit row; label, count, return; feedback at retry. Peer practice ≠ trainer observation.
display_en: Three audit rows; label, count, return; feedback and retry. Peer practice ≠ trainer observation.
narration_fil:
Gumawa ng tatlong row: resource, pag-aaksayang nakita, ebidensya at ligtas na susunod na hakbang. Gripo: nakitang patak, walang volume o bill—iulat, walang repair. Maling printout: version mismatch sa dummy master—ihiwalay at humingi ng tamang kopya. Nawawalang teaching cards: hindi makita sa itinakdang puwesto—hanapin, verify at bilangin bago mag-request.

Sa rotating triad, BHW, katrabaho at observer ang roles. Sa bawat anim na minuto: dalawa para sa setup, dalawa para sa attempt, isa sa feedback at isa sa retry. Ipakita ang label, usable count at return; itala ang role owner at susunod na check. Sabihin ang isang hindi pa alam. Kung nag-order sa hula ang unang attempt, ipaturo ang imbakan at master, ipabilang muli at ipaulit ang request na may ebidensya.

Trainer ang magtatala ng aktuwal na nakita at prompts ayon sa rubric. Sa 30 learners, tatlo lamang ang kayang bigyan ng buong apat-na-minutong trainer observation sa run na ito; hindi pa trainer-observed ang hindi bababa sa 27. Magtakda ng kasunod na observation. Paper o spoken solo rehearsal at peer feedback ay practice, hindi pass. Sa susunod na duty, talakayin ang isang obserbasyon sa supervisor; walang unsafe utility o clinical experiment.
narration_en:
Complete three rows: resource, observed waste, evidence and safe next step. Tap: visible drops, no volume or bill—report without repair. Wrong printout: version mismatch against the dummy master—set aside and request correct copies. Missing teaching cards: absent from the assigned location—find, verify and count before requesting.

Rotate BHW, colleague and observer roles in a triad. Each six-minute round gives two minutes to setup, two to an attempt, one to feedback and one to retry. Demonstrate the label, usable count and return; record the responsible role and next check. State one unknown. If the first attempt guessed an order, ask the learner to point out storage and the master, recount and repeat an evidence-based request.

The trainer records actual observed actions and prompts against the rubric. For 30 learners, only three complete four-minute trainer observations fit this run; at least 27 remain not trainer-observed. Schedule another observation opportunity. Paper or spoken solo rehearsal and peer feedback are practice, not a pass. On the next duty, discuss one observation with the supervisor; no unsafe utility or clinical experiment.

display_fil: Handouts hindi makita; count at version hindi pa verified. Ano muna?
display_en: Handouts missing; count and version unverified. What first?

check.prompt_fil: Hindi makita ang handouts kaya may gustong mag-order ulit. Ano muna?
check.prompt_en: Handouts cannot be found, so someone wants to reorder. What first?

options.fil: Mag-order agad ng doble para sigurado.
Suriin ang labeled storage, approved version at bilang ng stock.
options.en: Check labeled storage, approved version and stock count.

options.fil: Gamitin ang anumang lumang handout na makita.
options.en: Use any old handout that can be found.

check.feedback_fil: 1. Hindi sapat ang dobleng order sa hula; maaaring may usable stock na hindi lang makita. 2. Tama: suriin ang labeled storage, approved version at usable stock count bago humingi ng dagdag. 3. Hindi ligtas ang anumang lumang handout; dapat tama at aprubado ang bersyon. Sa kathang-isip na ending, nahanap ni Charlaine ang imbakan, kinumpirma ang master at binilang ang usable copies. Ipinakita niya ang label–count–return sa dummy kit at iniulat ang natitirang tunay na kakulangan sa supervisor. May audit at demonstrasyon; hindi pa naayos ang shortage at walang napatunayang financial savings.
check.feedback_en: 1. Guessing a double order is insufficient; usable stock may simply be misplaced. 2. Correct: check labeled storage, approved version and usable stock count before requesting more. 3. Any old handout is unsafe; the version must be correct and approved. In the fictional ending, Charlaine finds storage, confirms the master and counts usable copies. She demonstrates label–count–return with the dummy kit and reports the remaining genuine shortage to the supervisor. An audit and demonstration are complete; the shortage remains unresolved and financial savings are unproven.

narration_fil:
Hindi makita ang handouts. May gustong mag-order ulit. Wala pang natiyak na stock count o approved version sa sitwasyong ito. Hindi natin ipinapalagay na wala nang stock, kulang ang budget o may approval na sa dagdag order.

Tanong ng katrabaho kay Charlaine, “Ano muna?” Piliin ang sagot at sabihin kung anong ebidensya ang hahanapin bago tingnan ang feedback. Ang larawan ay sitwasyon bago ang desisyon; nasa feedback pagkatapos sumagot ang ligtas na correction at kathang-isip na ending.

Pagkatapos, ihambing ang sagot sa mismong label, count at return na ginawa mo sa practice. Ang pagpili ng tamang sagot o panonood ng kuwento ay hindi katibayan ng observed competence. Trainer ang magtatala ng demonstrasyon; facility review at owner approval ay hiwalay pa.
narration_en:
Handouts cannot be found. Someone wants to reorder. No stock count or approved version has yet been verified in this situation. Do not assume there is zero stock, an insufficient budget or approval for another order.

The colleague asks Charlaine, “What first?” Choose and explain which evidence to look for before reading feedback. The picture shows the situation before the decision; the safe correction and fictional ending appear in feedback after responding.

Then compare your answer with the label, count and return you actually practiced. Selecting the correct answer or watching a story is not evidence of observed competence. The trainer records the demonstration; facility review and owner approval remain separate.
